name: AI Platform Engineer
target: Infrastructure beneath AI products — serving, retrieval, evaluation, cost.

content.summary: AI platform engineer who takes systems from architecture to production on both Azure and AWS — model serving, queue-backed inference, CI/CD, observability and cost. Owns the HLD, LLD and deployment design for four government platforms now running in production, including a multilingual assistant live on kheloindia.gov.in and a drafting system piloted in a live 2026 Parliament session. Re-platformed one service onto ECS Fargate and cut another's run-rate ~60%. National-level athlete and 7x hackathon placer.

blocks.title: Khelo India Knowledge Assistant — live in production on kheloindia.gov.in

bullets.text: Owned the full Azure deployment: App Service API and worker off one image, Postgres Flexible with pgvector, Managed Redis in OSS cluster mode (hash-tagged keyspace for same-slot reads, plain client for pub/sub), Service Bus job queue, Blob ingestion and ACR with Managed Identity pull.

Built the streaming path — API enqueues a job, the worker publishes tokens to Redis pub/sub, the API relays SSE — plus a two-layer cache, idempotency keys and 14 feature flags including an instant env-flag kill switch for the agent graph, no redeploy required.

Modelled capacity and cost against real measurements: 10,000 daily users / 20,000 chats per hour, blended service time as a function of cache hit-rate, and a re-architecture that cut run-rate ~60% (₹9.4L → ₹3.5L per month); 532 offline tests and an eval harness that drives the deployed image over HTTP and records the shipped tag, git SHA and dirty flag on every run.

blocks.title: MYAS Task Tracker & Khelo India Expenditure Tracker — internal platforms, in production

bullets.text: Authored the architecture, HLD/LLD and deployment design for both, then re-platformed the task tracker from EC2 + PM2 onto ECS Fargate (ARM64) + RDS Postgres 16 + ALB/WAF — private subnets with NAT egress, autoscaling 1–6 tasks at 60% target CPU, Secrets Manager injection, and EventBridge cron jobs.

Built a GitHub OIDC CI/CD pipeline with no stored AWS keys: typecheck / lint / audit gate, Buildx ARM64 image with layer cache, JSON-rewritten task definition, and Prisma migrations executed as a one-off in-VPC Fargate task that aborts the deploy on a non-zero exit; third-party actions pinned to commit SHAs. Provisioned via 15 committed CLI runbook scripts.

Shipped the expenditure platform (₹924 Cr of scheme budget, 14 regional centres) on ECS Express + RDS + Secrets Manager with the same OIDC pipeline, plus security hardening — scrypt hashing, timing-attack-resistant login, rate limiting, Helmet CSP and HSTS.

blocks.title: PQ-Bot — Parliamentary Question drafting platform · MYAS / Sports Authority of India

bullets.text: Sole engineer on a ~60,000-LOC AWS Bedrock platform (95 endpoints, 34 tables, 33 migrations) piloted during the 2026 Parliament monsoon session; tuned the concurrency model — raised anyio worker limits, a shared fan-out executor, a 50-connection Bedrock pool and explicit transaction release before long LLM blocks so idle-in-transaction timeouts cannot kill connections.

Wrote the host-agnostic CI gate  driven by Jenkins off an OpenForge/Tuleap webhook, plus 21 feature flags, a Redis semantic cache and eval harnesses that gate releases; 312 backend tests green, SAST closed at zero critical findings.
